Task: Structured Document Extraction

Write Python code that normalizes extracted expense fields into a standard JSON schema using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
import os
import json
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional

import requests


OPENAI_API_KEY = os.environ["OPENAI_API_KEY"]
OPENAI_MODEL = os.environ.get("OPENAI_MODEL", "gpt-4o-mini")


STANDARD_EXPENSE_SCHEMA = {
    "merchant_name": None,
    "merchant_address": None,
    "merchant_phone": None,
    "transaction_date": None,
    "transaction_time": None,
    "currency": None,
    "subtotal": None,
    "tax": None,
    "tip": None,
    "total": None,
    "payment_method": None,
    "last4": None,
    "invoice_number": None,
    "receipt_number": None,
    "line_items": [],
    "notes": None,
}


def _coerce_number(value: Any) -> Optional[float]:
    if value is None or value == "":
        return None
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        return float(value)
    if isinstance(value, str):
        cleaned = value.strip().replace(",", "")
        for prefix in ("$", "€", "£", "¥", "₹"):
            cleaned = cleaned.replace(prefix, "")
        try:
            return float(cleaned)
        except ValueError:
            return None
    return None


def _normalize_line_items(items: Any) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    if not isinstance(items, list):
        return []

    normalized = []
    for item in items:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            continue
        normalized.append(
            {
                "description": item.get("description"),
                "quantity": _coerce_number(item.get("quantity")),
                "unit_price": _coerce_number(item.get("unit_price")),
                "amount": _coerce_number(item.get("amount") or item.get("total")),
                "category": item.get("category"),
            }
        )
    return normalized


def _shape_to_schema(data: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    result = dict(STANDARD_EXPENSE_SCHEMA)
    result["merchant_name"] = data.get("merchant_name")
    result["merchant_address"] = data.get("merchant_address")
    result["merchant_phone"] = data.get("merchant_phone")
    result["transaction_date"] = data.get("transaction_date")
    result["transaction_time"] = data.get("transaction_time")
    result["currency"] = data.get("currency")
    result["subtotal"] = _coerce_number(data.get("subtotal"))
    result["tax"] = _coerce_number(data.get("tax"))
    result["tip"] = _coerce_number(data.get("tip"))
    result["total"] = _coerce_number(data.get("total"))
    result["payment_method"] = data.get("payment_method")
    result["last4"] = data.get("last4")
    result["invoice_number"] = data.get("invoice_number")
    result["receipt_number"] = data.get("receipt_number")
    result["line_items"] = _normalize_line_items(data.get("line_items"))
    result["notes"] = data.get("notes")
    return result


def normalize_expense_fields(extracted_expense_fields: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    prompt = {
        "task": "Normalize extracted expense fields into the target schema. Preserve known values, infer field mapping only, do not invent missing values. Return valid JSON only.",
        "target_schema": STANDARD_EXPENSE_SCHEMA,
        "input": extracted_expense_fields,
        "normalization_rules": [
            "Use ISO 8601 date format YYYY-MM-DD when possible.",
            "Use 24-hour HH:MM:SS for transaction_time when possible.",
            "Use ISO 4217 currency code when possible.",
            "Map totals and monetary strings to numeric values where present.",
            "Keep line_items as an array of objects with description, quantity, unit_price, amount, category.",
            "If a value is not present or cannot be determined, use null.",
        ],
    }

    response = requests.post(
        "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions",
        headers={
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {OPENAI_API_KEY}",
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
        },
        json={
            "model": OPENAI_MODEL,
            "response_format": {"type": "json_object"},
            "messages": [
                {
                    "role": "system",
                    "content": "You normalize expense extraction results into a strict JSON schema.",
                },
                {
                    "role": "user",
                    "content": json.dumps(prompt),
                },
            ],
            "temperature": 0,
        },
        timeout=60,
    )
    response.raise_for_status()

    payload = response.json()
    content = payload["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
    normalized = json.loads(content)
    return _shape_to_schema(normalized)
